chiru: Khalaikhan tetrarch Herod na Jesu chungchanga rujet joi.
english: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the report about Jesus

chiru: Ama na shok hai dieng ruti, Hipa hi baptisma apeh John kha keng.
english: and said to his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead

chiru: Ajarla Herod na John kha shur a rukhop, khan lungroko shung ah rutet joi.
english: For Herod had laid hold of John and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias

chiru: Makha anaipangpa Philip nungak Herodia jar a inih.
english: Because John had said to him, It is not lawful for you to have her.

chiru: Ajarla John na ama dieng ruti, Ama nanginiei rang a hi Dan nimak.
english: And although he wanted to put him to death, he feared the multitude

chiru: Herod na ama kha ruthat jawt joiawm, ama na mirawp kha ruchih,
english: But when Herod's birthday was celebrated, the daughter of Herodias danced

chiru: Inia Herod shokna nikho hawng shok phakhan, Herodia shanu na amani kar a vak lam a Herod kha ajeng a ningruminit pe.
english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she might ask.

chiru: Iniklim kha pek rang, tia ama dieng chawngrurakham joi.
english: So she, having been prompted by her mother, said, Give me John the Baptist's head here on a platter.

chiru: Khan, unu na chawngirurachak le roroia, Hi rangmai chung hin baptisma apeh John lu kha nepeh roh, tia runik.
english: And the king was sorry; nevertheless, because of the oaths and because of those who sat with him, he commanded it to be given to her.

chiru: Makhan rengpa kha mulung rushaw pe, inia ama chawngrakham le koilawm hai jarkhan, makha pekna rang, chawng rupek joi.
english: So he sent and had John beheaded in prison.

chiru: Khan ama na rutir a lungroko shung khan John lu kha vak tuk pe joi.
english: And his head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, and she brought it to her mother.

chiru: Rangmai chung khan ulu kha vak chawi a nungaknu dieng rupek joi.
english: Then his disciples came and took away the body and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

chiru: Khan ama na unu dieng ruchawi joi.
english: When Jesus heard it, He departed from there by boat to a deserted place by Himself.

chiru: Khan akhaichawi hai kha na va ua ama rok kha ruloi u joi, khan vak khum u joi,
english: And when Jesus went out He saw a great multitude; and He was moved with compassion for them, and healed their sick.

chiru: Khashole rushe ua amani na Jesu dieng vak riei u joi.
english: When it was evening, His disciples came to Him, saying, This is a deserted place, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away

chiru: Jesu na rujet le, khan ah put ah ramthim ah thien a rokong a rushe joi.
english: But Jesus said to them, They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat.

chiru: Makha mirawp na rujet phakhan, khopui ah put ah eke a anu rujui uh.
english: And they said to Him, We have here only five loaves and two fish.

chiru: Jesu na kawmchang kha vak shok phakhan, mirawp lientak khat vak muk.
english: He said, Bring them here to Me.

chiru: Amani chung a lainatna runiei a amani natna kha rumadam pe.
english: Then He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass. And He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, He blessed and broke

chiru: Ni hawng tah phakhan, akhaichawi hai na ama dieng va a ruti uh, Mahi ramthim inih, khan pha awm shemeng joi.
english: So they all ate and were filled, and they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments that remained.

chiru: Jesu na amani dieng rumashang, Amani ashe rang a kha rangai mak, amani dieng shak rang peh u roh.
english: Now those who had eaten were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

chiru: Inia ama dieng ruti uh, Tanpek rahnga le nga di niboia niei u mi ing.
english: Immediately Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go before Him to the other side

chiru: Ama na ruti, Khahaikha hin kiei dieng vak chawi u roh.
english: And when He had sent the multitudes away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray.

chiru: Khashole mipui kha champi chung ah shutna rang, chawng rupek.
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, tossed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

chiru: Khan tanpek rahnga le nga di kha ruloi a, ama na ravan tieng khongalam a, rahvan rupek a rukhoi joi.
english: Now in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went to them, walking on the sea.

chiru: Khan tanpek hai kha khaichawi hai dieng rupek, khan akhaichawi hai kha na mipui dieng rushem pe.
english: And when the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a ghost! And they cried out for fear.

chiru: Amani kholok na rushak ua vawn ruship pe uh.
english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, Be of good cheer! It is I; do not be afraid.

chiru: Khan amani na lekvai mienieng hai kha tiengkum shawmlieidi shipmer rurawkhawm uh.
english: And Peter answered Him and said, Lord, if it is You, command me to come to You on the water.

chiru: Khan aneh-ashah hai kha, nupang le naite te boi a, apa bawp rahnga runih uh.
english: So He said, Come. And when Peter had come down out of the boat, he walked on the water to go to Jesus.

chiru: Khan relentak a Jesu na akhaichawi hai kha rokong ah lutna rang, rurawnawt mashak a vara khat tieng matieng rumeshe joi.
english: But when he saw that the wind was boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink he cried out, saying, Lord, save me!

chiru: Khariethiei khan mipui kha rureshen pui joi.
english: And immediately Jesus stretched out His hand and caught him, and said to him, O you of little faith, why did you doubt?

chiru: Mipui kha rumeshe shole, bing a anih rang. lawn ah ruhawng joi.
english: And when they got into the boat, the wind ceased.

chiru: Ni hawng tah phakhan, ama tu thien a ruawm joi.
english: Then those who were in the boat came and worshiped Him, saying, Truly You are the Son of God.

chiru: Inia rokong kha thampui laitak khan tuirawnawng na shehawng a runawng a ruawm.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

chiru: Ajarla rithi kha amani le rodoi a rujap.
english: And when the men of that place recognized Him, they sent out into all that surrounding region, brought to Him all who were sick

chiru: Khashole imili changna vengpa pha khan, Jesu na thampui chung ah vak lawn a amani dieng rushe joi.
english: and begged Him that they might only touch the hem of His garment. And as many as touched it were made perfectly well.
